card.title: How To Fix Samsung S22 Ultra With Red Temperature Warning Symbol

source.title: How To Fix Samsung S22 Ultra With Red Temperature Warning Symbol

symptoms: says too hot or too cold

claims.statement: Galaxy S22 Ultra showing a red exclamation / temperature warning on the charger is a board fault; unlike older models it does not need the wireless coil connected to charge.
Check USB_THM, the 3rd pin from the top right of charge FPC connector SOC25000: about 0.717 in diode mode is good; around 0.003 is a short.
A shorted USB_THM requires replacing U7002 (Qualcomm PM8350) inside the sandwich, which is very hard; data can be recovered by booting from a DC supply or a fully charged battery.

procedure: If shorted, plan U7002 (PM8350) replacement inside the sandwich.
For data recovery, boot from DC supply or a fully charged battery.
